_note: Model-provider egress registry (ADR-0018 §2, reframed 2026-07-01). A run OPTS IN to a provider via `pnpm forge agent <use-case> PROVIDER=<name>`, which sets the sandbox egress allowlist to that provider's host(s). This only NAMES what a run allows out; enforcement is the default-deny firewall (infra/agent-sandbox/scripts/init-firewall.sh). 'local' ⇒ zero external egress (the benchmark default). Unknown provider ⇒ the run fails closed. There is no agent-submitted manifest: anything not provided here is denied at the boundary at runtime.
